Name: Operation_Affix_Shifting_Stat_Type
Note: Rerolls stat type (e.g., Strength → random new stat). Can't be used on enchantments.

Name: Operation_Deterministic_Affix
BaseDays: 1 day per tier of affix. (Max of 8)

Name: Operation_Accelerate_Craft
Note: Removes the cumulative time penalty (-1 Day per stack).

Name: Operation_Upgrade_Affix_Tier
Note: Increases affix tier by 1, up to 7.

Name: Operation_Combine
Materials: Two stones of a level, or two gems of a kind and rarity
Note: Gold only: 50 gold for the lowest rung, a +1 stone or an Everyday gem, doubled for each rung above (the owner, 2026-11-21). No day: it changes no item.
